title: BaziQA-Benchmark: Evaluating Symbolic and Temporally Compositional Reasoning in Large Language Models
findings: Large Language Models perform significantly better than random chance on professional-grade Bazi reasoning problems, but their absolute accuracy remains far from expert-level. The models show significant weaknesses and sensitivity when dealing with temporal composition, reasoning order, and multi-condition symbolic judgments within the astrological framework.
references: Y. Shi, M. Sun, Z. Liu, M. Yang, Y. Fang, T. Sun, and X. Gu, "Reasoning in trees: Improving retrieval-augmented generation for multi-hop question answering," 2026.
